Rename done. All `calcTotal` gone.

- `src/cart.js` — function + export + comment
- `src/index.js` — require + export
- `src/invoice.js` — require + call
- `src/report.js` — require + call

Tests: `node --test tests/total.test.js` — 4 pass, 0 fail.

Note: no alias kept, because test asserts `cart.calcTotal === undefined`. Breaking change for downstream callers.

Side note: `node --test tests/` (trailing slash) fails with `Cannot find module ...\tests` — Node treats it as module path, not test dir. Use `node --test tests` or the file path. Not caused by rename.
